# Tests the full Windows suite expects to fail because their data is not available to CI.
# The full-tests job fails only when a test NOT listed here fails, and reports listed tests that
# started passing (remove them here). One test name per line; blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# CI supplies upstream's release bundle (connector helpers, LDCad shadow library, search
# catalogue); with release v0.2.0 (job 135166751701: 157 passed, these 35 failed):
# - The connector backend imports validate.py, scene.py and orient.py, which were added after
#   v0.2.0, so it stops on `import validate`: connect/hinge/check/verify tests see "pipe is being
#   closed" / "Connector backend stopped". Expected to pass once a newer release ships them.
# - Some tests read models from bench-next/tests/connections, which no release bundle contains.
# - meshes_match_python: the reference fixture was made with a different LDraw library release
#   than the one CI downloads; the hinge/click parts 30383, 30553, 44301a, 44302a and 44567a differ.
